stemMd: The equations $2x+3y=12$ and $4x+6y=k$ have infinitely many solutions for which $k$?
explanationMd: The second left side is twice the first. The right side must also double to describe the same line. Otherwise the parallel equations are inconsistent.

distractorRationale.c: Uses an additive rather than multiplicative adjustment.
distractorRationale.a: Assumes dependence requires a zero constant.
distractorRationale.b: Leaves the constant unchanged while doubling coefficients.
